summary: Detected categories of pagination inconsistencies and implemented normalization, bounds enforcement, cache isolation hints, and deterministic ordering.

issues_found.duplicate_page_params: Multiple page params -> normalized by selecting the first valid integer
issues_found.excessive_page: Large page values are clamped to max_page_allowed; request may return empty to avoid heavy offsets
issues_found.page_array_encoding: page[] arrays mapped to first element
issues_found.offset_limit_mapping: offset/limit converted to page/per_page by integer division
issues_found.empty_param: Empty page values treated as page=1
issues_found.timestamp_tie: Added deterministic tiebreaker (id DESC) for timestamp ordering
issues_found.cache_isolation: Detect user-sensitive requests and recommend cache key isolation

applied_changes: Added models.safe_paginate_query with bounds enforcement and empty-trap for extreme pages
Added models.apply_deterministic_sort to append id as tiebreaker
Added unit tests for all described anomalies
recommendations: Canonicalize pagination at CDN/gateway before caching
Use keyset pagination for deep navigation instead of large offsets
Include user identity in cache key or mark user-specific endpoints as non-cacheable
Ensure ordering includes deterministic keys when using time-based order_by
